***

Strategically located in the industrial heartland of Germany's Lower Rhine region, PETREX GmbH stands as a distinguished specialist in the global chemical trade. Operating from its headquarters at Wachtendonker Straße 11 in Kempen, the company has carved out a significant niche as a trusted trading and service partner for a specialized range of products, primarily focusing on waxes, paraffins, and petroleum jellies. Far more than a simple distributor, PETREX acts as a vital link between international producers and a diverse array of industrial consumers, ensuring a seamless and reliable supply of essential raw materials.

PETREX's core expertise lies in its comprehensive portfolio, which includes various grades of paraffin waxes, microcrystalline waxes, wax blends, and high-quality petrolatum (vaseline). These products are fundamental to a multitude of industries. In the cosmetic and pharmaceutical sectors, their highly refined products serve as base materials for creams, ointments, and personal care items. For the candle industry, they provide the consistent quality necessary for perfect combustion and form. Furthermore, their waxes are crucial in the packaging industry for coating paper and cardboard, in the rubber and tire industry as processing aids, and in numerous other applications, from adhesives and construction materials to textiles.

With its unwavering commitment to quality assurance, flexible logistics, and the development of customer-specific solutions, PETREX GmbH has solidified its reputation. The company leverages its prime location near major European ports and transport routes to efficiently manage a global supply chain, embodying the precision, reliability, and deep market knowledge that define a leader in the specialized chemical trade.
